 It doesn't look like one that will trouble Gianluigi Donnarumma too much but the Italian almost lets it slip through his gloves and it goes over the bar for a corner.

 294 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Around the grounds... published at 20:17 GMT 20:17 GMT 
 Lens 0-1 Como; Porto 1-0 Napoli; Viking 0-1 Sabah 
 Image source, Getty Images After their 4-1 success at Manchester United last time out, Como are in front at Lens thanks to Tasos Douvikas' tap in from two yards out.
 Pepe thought he had opened the scoring for Porto when he found the roof of the Napoli net with a smashed finish, but it was ruled out for offside before a bullet header from Jan Bednarek gave the hosts the lead after 11 minutes.
 And Azerbaijan side Sabah are up against fellow Champions League debutants Viking when Orphe Mbina, unmarked in the box, slotted home. 
 33 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Great performance, we dug in until the end' published at 20:17 GMT 20:17 GMT 
 FT: Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 Fenerbahce 
 Fenerbahce striker Mason Greenwood: "It was a great performance from the team, we dug in until the end and always thought we'd have a chance to win the game, even though we went 1-0 down.
 "I want to congratulate all the coaching staff, the players and especially the fans for getting behind us. We're very happy to get this win tonight."
 On what was said before the game: "Just that we were all going to suffer together because we know Liverpool are one of the best teams in Europe. They've got great players at the top of the pitch.
 "We knew if we stuck together in the difficult moments, in the low block, we'd be able to create chances, catch them on the break like we did in the first half. Then we knew we'd be very good in the air, would be able to create some chances, we managed to take them and get the win."
